jobs.raw_jd_text:
Data Scientist — Consumer Analytics Team

About the role: You will partner with product managers and analysts to frame ambiguous questions, build predictive models, and communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders. Success means measurable lift in campaign performance and clear written narratives behind every recommendation.

Minimum qualifications:
- 2+ years of experience with Python for data work
- Strong SQL for joining large event tables and window functions
- Hands-on Machine Learning model training and validation
- Fluency with Pandas for wrangling messy datasets
- Experience with Scikit-learn pipelines and cross-validation

Preferred qualifications:
- Exposure to AWS data services
- Familiarity with Docker for reproducible notebooks
- Dashboarding with Tableau
jobs.title: Data Scientist

jobs.raw_jd_text:
Python Backend Engineer — Platform Team

About the role: You will own services that ingest partner feeds, enforce schema contracts, and keep p99 latency low during peak traffic. You will review peers' code, write design notes, and share on-call rotations with the team.

Must have:
- 3+ years building with Python
- Designing versioned REST API endpoints with auth and pagination
- Relational modeling in SQL with careful indexing
- Shipping with Docker images through code review
- Daily use of Git branching and pull requests

Good to have:
- Deployments on AWS
- Exposure to Kubernetes manifests
- Document modeling with MongoDB
jobs.title: Python Backend Engineer

jobs.raw_jd_text:
DevOps Engineer — Infrastructure Team

About the role: You will keep staging and production healthy, shorten the path from merge to deploy, and document runbooks so on-call stays quiet. You enjoy deleting toil with automation and teaching developers safe rollout habits.

Required:
- Building minimal Docker images and registries
- Operating Kubernetes clusters, rollouts, and rollbacks
- Maintaining CI/CD with Jenkins and shared runners
- Fluency in Linux administration and shell scripting
- Networking and IAM fundamentals on AWS

Bonus:
- Scripting helpers in Python
- Versioning infra snippets with Git
- Any exposure to GCP
jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
